expected_assessment: Feature request despite the bug label: show/hide_virtual_keyboard exist but XboxGameUI declares no signals, so there is no way to observe the keyboard opening or closing. CoreInputView showing/hiding events are the likely source.

evidence.why: Show/hide call CoreInputView TryShow/TryHide and return only an accepted bool.
C# wrapper would need matching events.

key_facts: TryShow/TryHide results are best-effort requests, not state.
Events must be marshalled to the Godot main thread.
acceptable_uncertainty: Exact CoreInputView event names and availability on the target Windows SDK.
Whether events fire for keyboards not opened by the app.
avoid: Treating the bug label as proof of a defect.
